overall_assessment: HiOF extraction is good: 17 of 18 courses split correctly, arbeidskrav land in coursework_requirements, Praksis in teaching_methods, and logistics headings are dropped. One real, high-impact defect: a learning-outcome sub-heading 'Litteratur:' is mapped to reading_list and moves most of the learning outcomes there. Most pre-pass flags are false alarms; one leak flag (assessment vs coursework) is a mild real overlap.

findings.evidence: Studenten har kunnskap om sentrale litterære tendenser, sjangere og forfattere fra de tysktalende land i tida fra 1945 til i dag. Kultur: Studenten har
findings.description: The sub-heading 'Litteratur:' inside 'Studentens læringsutbytte' (a sub-heading of Kunnskap, used as a topic label for outcomes about literature) is mapped to reading_list. The learning-outcome text from there to 'Generell kompetanse' (Kunnskap, Kultur, all of Ferdigheter, 767 chars) is filed as reading_list, while learning_outcomes keeps only 98 chars. Learning outcomes are cut short and the reading list is polluted with outcome statements (flags: short on learning_outcomes, leak->learning_outcomes on reading_list are real here).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps the pattern 'litteratur' to reading_list for any heading, including sub-headings (sub) that appear inside a learning_outcomes block. The block reader treats 'Litteratur:' (with a colon) as a section boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: For hiof, make sub-headings (sub) found while inside learning_outcomes not switch section (stay in learning_outcomes) unless they are Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse; or exempt headings ending in ':' from the 'litteratur' pattern (anchor the pattern to the whole heading and do not match when it carries a trailing colon in a sub position).

findings.evidence: Underveisvurdering Student og faglærer skal gjennomføre minst én veiledningstime. Sluttvurdering Arbeidskravene må være utført innen fastsatt frist og godkjent av faglærer før studenten kan fremstille seg til eksamen.
findings.description: Under 2007-era plans the Eksamen block contains 'Underveisvurdering' and 'Sluttvurdering' sub-sections (both unmapped) that restate the arbeidskrav (one supervision hour, arbeidskrav approved before exam). This text is a pass/approve gate, which the codebook places in coursework_requirements, yet it stays in assessment (duplicating the coursework row). The pre-pass flag leak->coursework_requirements is correct but the impact is small; the real exam design (deleksamen, hovedeksamen, karaktersystem) is intact.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The sub-headings 'Underveisvurdering' and 'Sluttvurdering' have no entry in R/section_heading_map.R, so their text is appended to the preceding assessment block.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'underveisvurdering' mapped to coursework_requirements (or .drop) in R/section_heading_map.R, keeping 'sluttvurdering' in assessment; accept the arbeidskrav sentence duplication or strip the sentence beginning 'Arbeidskravene må være utført innen' in .clean_sections().

findings.evidence: PlagiatkontrollAlle skriftlige arbeidskrav og eksamensoppgaver kan plagiatkontolleres.
findings.description: A generic plagiarism-control notice (administrative boilerplate, with heading and text glued together without whitespace) is kept at the end of assessment. It is not assessment design.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Plagiatkontroll' paragraph is a bold label inside the Eksamen block, not an h2/h3 heading, so it is not mapped to .drop and is not caught by .strip_section_noise().
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line pattern to the section noise in R/extract_sections.R removing '(?m)^Plagiatkontroll.*$' (and 'Plagiering og avskrift av faglitteratur[^\n]*') from assessment for hiof.
